name: Solstice Advanced Materials Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: patent-protected low-GWP refrigerant franchise (5,700+ issued patents and pending applications per the company's 2026 proxy), the sole US uranium conversion operation in Nuclear (Alternative Energy Services), and qualification-based switching costs in semiconductor sputtering targets and Spectra fibers. Against that, gross margin fell from 35.2% (FY2023) to 34.6% (FY2024) to 32.2% (FY2025) in fundamentals.json, roic_proxy is null for every year in fundamentals.json (operating income is not tagged, so no ROIC series can be quoted), and refrigerant patents face Chemours/Daikin competition and eventual expiry. A 5 sits on demonstrated pricing/franchise positions without the through-cycle ROIC evidence a 7+ requires — and there is no standalone track record before the October 30, 2025 Honeywell spin-off.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.48 vs 3-yr median 2.79 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.6% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 9.5x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Real specialty-materials franchise, moat 5/10, but on standalone cash economics it does not clear 15%: TTM owner's earnings are $0.96/share after the post-spin capex step-up, giving a 4.5% weighted IRR and a weighted IV@15% of $9.27 vs the $60.47 price — it would need to trade near $9.27 to clear 15% on these inputs.
moat_for: Patent-protected low-GWP refrigerants (Solstice 454B / HFO transition) with regulatory tailwind
5,700+ issued patents and pending applications across the portfolio (2026 proxy)
Nuclear Alternative Energy Services — sole US uranium conversion capacity, accelerating backlog
Qualification switching costs in semiconductor sputtering targets and electronic materials
Spectra high-strength fibers and healthcare packaging niches with spec-in positions
moat_against: Gross margin eroding: 35.2% FY2023 -> 34.6% FY2024 -> 32.2% FY2025 (fundamentals.json)
Refrigerant competition from Chemours and Daikin; HFO patent expiries over time
No ROIC evidence: roic_proxy is null in fundamentals.json (operating income untagged); ROE on a carve-out equity base is not a standalone record
Cyclical end markets (construction, autos, semiconductors) and customer qualification can be dual-sourced
No standalone operating history before the Oct 30, 2025 spin-off; standalone cost base still settling
